event_chain.summary: Classified documents photographed and passed to handler

summary: A serving Indian Air Force Wing Commander posted at a field unit on the Western Front was honey-trapped via social media by a woman acting for Pakistani intelligence and allegedly shared classified defence documents, deployment information and other sensitive material as photographs and videos. He also allegedly installed spyware on a fellow officer's mobile phone. IAF intelligence / Delhi Police electronic surveillance (reported as starting January 2026) detected him; he was arrested on May 30-31 2026 and charged under the Official Secrets Act, with a charge sheet filed July 30 2026.
